question.text: What is the difference between registration and title, what ages apply, and how soon must new residents register?

answer.text: Registration permits road use while the title proves ownership; registration needs age sixteen, titling any age, and new residents must register within thirty days.

answer.text: Sellers and traders strip plates and the windshield sticker first, or strangers parking tickets may bill the old owner.

answer.text: Expiries landing on weekends or state holidays stretch automatically to midnight of the next business day with insurance maintained throughout.
